run_boost_copy_time_test: run the Boost.Build test that verifies common.copy sets the modification date of copied files to the current time
test_boostbuild_tester_write: test the BoostBuild.Tester write method by creating C++ source files and a jamroot.jam build file
test_boostbuild_tester_run_build_system: test the BoostBuild.Tester run_build_system method to compile C++ sources and verify object file output
test_boostbuild_tester_expect_addition: test the BoostBuild.Tester expect_addition method to assert expected build artifacts were created in the output directory
test_boostbuild_tester_read_binary: test the BoostBuild.Tester read method in binary mode to compare copied object file contents for correctness
